notes.title: Amanda The Adventurer 3 is coming...
notes.content:
[h1]The end is nigh.[/h1]

In [i][b]Amanda the Adventurer 3[/b][/i], continue Riley Park’s journey, immediately following the events of the previous game, as they discover the truth behind the ongoing mysteries surrounding Amanda and Hameln.

In the final game, play through a return to form, taking the best elements of both previous games to create an experience that is bound to thrill both returning and new players alike.

The Steam Page is finally here! So watch the trailer, and don't forget to wishlist [i][b]Amanda The Adventurer 3.[/b][/i]


[previewyoutube=jO4aBp8OYMA;full]https://youtu.be/jO4aBp8OYMA[/previewyoutube]
